rationale: Filterable NBS national legal-act register; core recurring source of SK banking/payments rules and effective dates.
Navigation hub enumerating NBS legislative streams; mine once for sub-portals, then monitor the children.
AML/CFT guidance stream for banks and PI/EMI with its own publication cadence and deadlines.
NBS consultation portal with fixed comment windows; earliest pre-legislative warning channel.
Same pripomienkové-konanie register as c_024 (trailing-slash variant); keep only one canonical entry.
Register of EBA/ESMA guidelines adopted by NBS — maps EU payment/banking deadlines onto SK supervision.
Vestník NBS is the authoritative publication venue for NBS acts; year-by-year archive keeps producing.
SLOV-LEX chronological register of NBS opatrenia; binding consolidated text with machine-friendly URL patterns.
Payments-vertical supervision hub (PI/EMI/AISP licensing conditions); payments weighted equally with banking.
EN mirror of the SK payments supervision hub; lags and carries no legal force — covered by the parent.
EN statute index on the same NBS legislation tree; useful once for the statutory backbone, not a separate feed.
NBS news feed with subscription option; fastest channel for consultations, decisions and warnings.
Authoritative register of supervised banks/PI/EMI/AISP; actor map plus licence-change signals.
Enforcement/sanctioning disclosure revealing real supervisory priorities beyond written rules.
Reporting-system (STATUS-DFT) guidance and form definitions; densest source of recurring compliance deadlines.
Quarterly macroprudential commentary and buffer decisions binding on SK banks with explicit application dates.
Annual supervision activity report series; recurring index giving inspection/sanction trends and next-year priorities.
Single aktuality article announcing the sandbox; evidence of the innovation facilitator, not a standalone feed.
DORA register-of-information / MiCA thematic supervision page with hard submission deadlines.
One-off Dear CEO letter PDF on the legacy tree; valuable evidence of expectations but not a producing source.
Legacy www.nbs.sk corpus; mine once for historical depth and 404 recovery rather than monitor continuously.
Static whistleblowing process page on nbs.sk; near-zero update volume, covered by the supervision tree.
NBS taxonomy of instrument types; read once as the schema authority for classifying harvested documents.
Structured table of NBS draft measures with LP numbers and comment deadlines — the core deadline feed for A3.
NBS consultation papers to the professional public, each with an explicit submission deadline; low volume, high signal.
SLOV-LEX MPK portal: authoritative record of every draft law/measure, comment period dates and submitters.
Predbežná informácia register gives the earliest signal of planned SK transposition of EU banking/payments acts.
Single 2025 Vestník issue page; a child of the Vestník hub already kept at c_007.
Per-measure detail repository for adopted opatrenia; canonical text plus dates linking back to LP entries.
